en.headline: Leisure and Cultural Services Department opens Fun@Museum Carnival this weekend
en.dek: The free event at Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza runs from 31 October to 1 November with themed installations and workshops under the Muse Fest HK 2026 theme.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department is holding the Fun@Museum Carnival as the opening programme of Muse Fest HK 2026 at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza from 31 October to 1 November.

Under the theme A Collage of Past and Present, Hong Kong Story, the free event features installations including a recreated neighbourhood tea stall, a giant pixel egg tart that visitors can decorate with stickers, a traditional Chinese medicine shop setting, and a coin-throwing game recalling old amusement parks.

Workshops cover activities such as pineapple bun clay making, herbal tea keychain crafting, and other hands-on sessions. Performances and science demonstrations are also scheduled. All activities are free of charge and open from 11:00 to 18:00 each day.
The department said the carnival responds to the Hong Kong Story exhibition at the Hong Kong Museum of History and forms part of the wider museum festival programme.

zh.headline: 康文署周末舉行繽Fun博物館嘉年華
zh.dek: 香港文化中心露天廣場10月31日至11月1日免費舉辦開幕活動，設主題裝置及工作坊。
body: 康樂及文化事務署在香港文化中心露天廣場舉行「香港博物館節2026」開幕節目「繽Fun博物館嘉年華」，日期為10月31日至11月1日。
活動以「拼貼今昔，香港故事」為主題，設有格仔茶檔、巨型像素蛋撻（市民可貼像素貼紙）、香江藥號中藥舖場景及重現舊日遊樂場掟銀幣攤位等裝置。
同場有菠蘿包黏土、涼茶牌鎖匙扣等免費工作坊，以及表演和科普活動。所有活動免費，每日上午11時至下午6時開放。
康文署表示，嘉年華回應香港歷史博物館的「香港故事」展覽，屬博物館節系列節目之一。
